core.title: 8 Inch Bronze Push Plate, Hamilton RPP-02

text.description_html:
Hamilton RPP-02 Bronze Push Plate 8Inch

This handsome rectangular push plate is made of solid bronze. With such a beautiful bronze patina finish, it will add an elegance to any home. Measuring 8 inches long and is made with the attention to quality that Hamilton backs by a limited lifetime warranty.

Specifications of the Hamilton Decorative Push Plate RPP-02:

  • Made of solid authentic bronze with bronze patina finish.
  • made with traditional high end, high quality craftsmanship.
  • Limited Lifetime Warranty.
  • Length: 8"
  • Width: 2-1/2"
  • Width: 1/2"
